questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

117 ÷ 7 + 426 × 6 − 66 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

117 ÷ 7 + 426 × 6 − 66 = ?

After applying the interchange rules, the equation becomes:

117 × 7 − 426 ÷ 6 + 66 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= **117 × 7**__ − __**426 ÷ 6**__ + 66

= __**819 − 71**__ + 66

= __**748 + 66**__

= 814

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ is replaced by ‘−’ and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

44 ÷ 8 + 5 × 1 + 7 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ is replaced by ‘−’.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

44 ÷ 8 + 5 × 1 + 7 = ?

After applying the interchange rules, the equation becomes:

44 × 8 − 5 ÷ 1 − 7 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= **44 × 8**__ − __**5 ÷ 1**__ − 7

= __**352 − 5**__ − 7

= __**347 − 7**__

= 340

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: LIQM is related to JGOK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, IFNJ is related to GDLH. To which of the given options is OLTP related, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter of the first term is shifted backward by 2 positions to get the second term. The pattern can be summarized as **(-2, -2, -2, -2)**.

**Pair 1: LIQM : JGOK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3488aae70355833fc48624ff61f293855aba98dc1097973ce904f6c358a25619.png] 

 

**Pair 2: IFNJ : GDLH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e3b9f8bffc0ad9266be72cefe385711053eb5ece8ecd865bcce704938c8c24f.png] 

**Applying the logic to OLTP:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87814a618ba6eed0a54b4fc4654f60c675fed17f58063b9c346a1a0a2baf63df.png] 

Thus, OLTP is related to **MJRN**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**.
